Lessons.Title: Fractions as Sums
ExplanationParagraphs: Learning goal: You will decompose a fraction into a sum of fractions with the same denominator in more than one way, and to write an equation for each decomposition.
Key idea: A fraction is a sum of fractional parts with the same-sized denominator, and it can be decomposed in multiple valid ways.
How to reason: Decompose or add numerators when the denominators name equal-size units; preserve the total.
Source-inspired opening: Warm-up: Choral Count: Three-fourths at a Time (10 minutes). Use the teacher-provided mathematical representations and explain how different valid answers arise.

Activity 1: Barley Soup (20 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(\frac{3}{4}\), \(\frac{5}{4}\), \(\frac{6}{4}\), 1 cup of chopped onions. First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.

Activity 2: Sums in Fifths and Thirds (15 minutes): apply the learning goal to quantities such as \(\frac{9}{5}\), \(\frac{9}{5} = \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}}\), \(\frac{9}{5} = \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}}\), \(\frac{9}{5} = \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}} + \underline{\hspace{.5in}}\). First-party discussion supports clear strategies and comparisons, while original drawings and classroom materials are teacher-led.
Original source Cool-down is access-restricted/unverified; Edulytics substitutes goal-aligned independently authored teacher-reviewed exit prompt.
Edulytics worked model: Show 9/5 as a sum of 4/5 and another amount.. Explain every transformation and check using equal wholes/units.
